domains.name: Cross-market
domains.summary: Cross-session inventory and multi-session trend framing.

domains.name: Events
domains.summary: Formalized event stream: lifecycle (open → updated → resolved|expired), severity, dedup identity, frameRef to the producing Journal Frame, and capsuleRef on DOM-family rows (stop_run, iceberg_reload, pull_intent, book_velocity_regime_shift). Reads ride get_events; the attention inbox is a ranked view over this stream.

domains.name: Flow
domains.summary: Participation and aggression: delta, tape pace, absorption, pinch, trade size, leg-to-leg profiles.

domains.name: Identity
domains.summary: Instrument identity, session labels, and contract resolution metadata.

domains.name: Liquidity
domains.summary: Order-book / DOM liquidity summaries when depth context is available.

domains.name: Location / structure
domains.summary: Price location and auction structure: VWAP, TPO VA/POC, DNVA/DNP, IB/OR/OR5, day type.

domains.name: Meta
domains.summary: Catalog and envelope metadata (version pins, cost bands).

domains.name: Positioning
domains.summary: Dealer/options Positioning — grid aggregations, by-strike positions, greek Slices, and first-class Levels-Only Records. Manual write via positioning_entry; no live Vs3dProvider.

domains.name: Response
domains.summary: Market response structures such as rebid/reoffer acceleration zones.

domains.name: Volatility
domains.summary: Relative volume and related session volatility framing.

fields.name: inventoryDirection

fields.name: inventoryState

fields.description: Consecutive sessions with same-direction delta.

fields.name: absorptionEventCount
fields.description: Number of recent absorption events.

fields.name: avgTradeSize

fields.name: confirmedAbsorptionEventCount
fields.description: Number of confirmed absorption events.

fields.name: confirmedDeltaDivergenceEventCount
fields.description: Number of confirmed delta divergence events.

fields.name: confirmedExhaustionEventCount
fields.description: Number of confirmed exhaustion events.

fields.name: cumulativeDelta

fields.name: globexDelta
fields.description: Combined Globex delta (Asia + London) from 6 PM ET. Only present during Globex; null during RTH.

fields.name: hasRecentConfirmedAbsorption
fields.description: Whether there is a still-live confirmed absorption near current price.

fields.name: hasRecentConfirmedExhaustion
fields.description: Whether there is a still-live confirmed exhaustion signal.

fields.name: hasRecentInvalidatedAbsorption
fields.description: Whether a recently *invalidated* absorption is live (IDEA-012 failure / vacuum).

fields.name: imbalanceCount
fields.description: Recent stacked imbalance count.

fields.name: lastLegDirection
fields.description: Direction of the last completed rotation (`up` / `down`).

fields.name: lastLegNetDelta
fields.description: Net delta of the last completed rotation (same attribution as `last_leg_volume`).

fields.name: lastLegPoc
fields.description: Volume POC of the last completed rotation.

fields.name: lastLegVolume
fields.description: Traded volume of the last completed rotation (swing through that rotation's extreme; excludes the subsequent counter-move).

fields.name: legAgeMs
fields.description: Milliseconds since the active-leg swing anchor (same instant as `leg_anchor_time_ms`).

fields.name: legAnchorPrice
fields.description: Price of the active-leg swing extreme (last confirmed swing). Zero when `none`.

fields.name: legAnchorTimeMs
fields.description: Timestamp (ms) when the active-leg swing extreme last printed, not the later reversal-confirmation time.

fields.name: legDeltaPoc
fields.description: Price with the largest absolute delta in the active-leg delta profile (delta-profile control).

fields.name: legDirection
fields.description: Confirmed swing direction of the active rotation (`up` / `down`) when known.

fields.name: legHvn
fields.description: Highest-volume node of the active leg (compact snapshot: same as `leg_poc`; no clustering).

fields.name: legLvn
fields.description: Lowest-volume node of the active-leg map (excludes POC when more than one price traded).

fields.name: legNetDelta
fields.description: Net delta (ask buys minus bid sells) in the active rotation (same attribution as `leg_volume`).

fields.name: legPoc
fields.description: Volume point of control of the active leg. Zero when the rotation is `insufficient` or `none`.

fields.name: legPocAtSessionPoc
fields.description: True when mature leg POC is within two ticks of the same-session TPO POC.

fields.name: legPocInSessionDnva
fields.description: True when mature leg POC sits inside the current delta-segment DNVA (two-tick band).

fields.name: legPocInSessionVa
fields.description: True when mature leg POC sits inside the same-session TPO value area (two-tick band).

fields.name: legStatus
fields.description: Active rotation status: `none` (no trades), `insufficient` (too new/unstable), or `active` (mature).

fields.name: legVaHigh
fields.description: Active-leg value area high (70% of leg volume, expand from volume POC among occupied prices).

fields.name: legVaLow
fields.description: Active-leg value area low (70% of leg volume, expand from volume POC among occupied prices).

fields.name: legVaOverlapsSessionVa
fields.description: True when the mature leg VA overlaps the same-session TPO value area.

fields.name: legVolume
fields.description: Traded volume in the active rotation (swing through current extreme; counter-move prints transfer to the next leg at confirmation).

fields.name: pacePercentile
fields.description: Current pace percentile vs session distribution (0.0-1.0).

fields.name: pinchEventCount
fields.description: Number of recent pinch events.

fields.name: recentConfirmedAbsorptionAgeMs
fields.description: Age of the most recent confirmed absorption in milliseconds.

fields.name: recentConfirmedAbsorptionDirection
fields.description: Direction implied by the most recent confirmed absorption.

fields.name: recentConfirmedAbsorptionDistanceTicks
fields.description: Distance from current price to the most recent confirmed absorption, in ticks.

fields.name: recentConfirmedAbsorptionPrice
fields.description: Price of the most recent confirmed absorption considered live for evaluation.

fields.name: recentConfirmedExhaustionAgeMs
fields.description: Age of the most recent confirmed exhaustion in milliseconds.

fields.name: recentConfirmedExhaustionDirection
fields.description: Direction implied by the most recent confirmed exhaustion.

fields.name: recentConfirmedExhaustionPrice
fields.description: Price of the most recent confirmed exhaustion considered live for evaluation.

fields.name: recentInvalidatedAbsorptionAgeMs
fields.description: Age of the most recent invalidated absorption (since it failed), in milliseconds.

fields.name: recentInvalidatedAbsorptionDirection
fields.description: Direction implied by the most recent invalidated absorption.

fields.name: recentInvalidatedAbsorptionDistanceTicks
fields.description: Distance from current price to the most recent invalidated absorption, in ticks.

fields.name: recentInvalidatedAbsorptionPrice
fields.description: Price of the most recent invalidated absorption.

fields.name: sessionDelta
fields.description: Segment delta: Asia-only, London-only, or RTH-only. Resets at Asia→London (2 AM) and RTH↔Globex.

fields.name: tapeAcceleration
fields.description: Smoothed and normalized tape acceleration.

fields.name: tapeCoverage30S
fields.description: Window coverage ratio for the 30-second tape window (0.0-1.0).

fields.name: tapeCoverage5M
fields.description: Window coverage ratio for the 5-minute tape window (0.0-1.0).

fields.name: tapeCoverage5S
fields.description: Window coverage ratio for the 5-second tape window (0.0-1.0).

fields.name: tapeDwellAtCurrentPriceMs
fields.description: Dwell time at the current price level using the event-time anchor.

fields.name: tapeEventTimeLagMs
fields.description: Event-time lag between tape anchor and last trade (ms).

fields.name: tapeLastTradeTimestampMs
fields.description: Timestamp of the last trade included in the tape snapshot (ms).

fields.name: tapePace30S
fields.description: Rolling 30-second tape pace (ticks/sec) when the window has sufficient coverage.

fields.name: tapePace5M
fields.description: Rolling 5-minute tape pace (ticks/sec) when the window has sufficient coverage.

fields.name: tapePace5S
fields.description: Rolling 5-second tape pace (ticks/sec) when the window has sufficient coverage.

fields.name: tapeRawAcceleration
fields.description: Raw 5s minus 30s pace spread for debugging and calibration.

fields.name: tapeRegimeTicksPerSec30MEma
fields.description: Longer-horizon tape regime baseline (ticks/sec EMA).

fields.name: tapeRegimeVolumePerSec30MEma
fields.description: Longer-horizon tape regime baseline (volume/sec EMA).

fields.name: tapeRollingPercentile
fields.description: Current pace percentile vs the recent rolling intraday distribution (0.0-1.0).

fields.name: tapeValid30S
fields.description: Whether the 30-second tape window has enough event-time coverage to trust.

fields.name: tapeValid5M
fields.description: Whether the 5-minute tape window has enough event-time coverage to trust.

fields.name: tapeValid5S
fields.description: Whether the 5-second tape window has enough event-time coverage to trust.

fields.name: tapeVolumePerSec30S
fields.description: Rolling 30-second tape volume pace (contracts/sec).

fields.name: tapeVolumePerSec5M
fields.description: Rolling 5-minute tape volume pace (contracts/sec).

fields.name: tapeVolumePerSec5S
fields.description: Rolling 5-second tape volume pace (contracts/sec).

fields.name: tapeWindowAnchorTimestampMs
fields.description: Event-time anchor timestamp for the tape snapshot (ms).

fields.name: rolloverWarning

fields.name: rvolAcceleration
fields.description: RVOL acceleration: second derivative of ratio.

fields.name: rvolBaselineStatus
fields.description: RVOL baseline quality: ok, partial, synthetic, or unavailable.

fields.name: rvolBucketIndex
fields.description: Current 5-minute bucket index.

fields.name: rvolCaveat
fields.description: Human-readable caveat when the baseline is partial or unavailable.

fields.name: rvolClassification
fields.description: RVOL classification.

fields.name: rvolExpectedVolume
fields.description: Expected cumulative volume at the current bucket from the baseline.

fields.name: rvolLookbackDaysActual
fields.description: Number of historical same-session curves available at the current bucket.

fields.name: rvolPercentile
fields.description: RVOL percentile rank vs historical days at same time-of-day (0-100).

fields.name: rvolRatio
fields.description: RVOL ratio (1.0 = tracking average). Serializes as null when unavailable.

fields.name: rvolVelocity
fields.description: RVOL velocity: rate of change of ratio per 5-min bucket.

fields.name: asOf
fields.description: Explicit manual/as-of timestamp for a Positioning record. Missing/stale as-of fails closed and is never live vendor data.

fields.name: capturedAt
fields.description: Desk capture / annotation timestamp for a Positioning record (manual as-of on the Levels-Only path).

fields.name: completeness
fields.description: First-class completeness of the current Positioning record. levels_only is a first-class kind — the ToS-denial steady state and historical backlog path.

fields.name: dataTime
fields.description: Vendor data time when a provider exists; null on the Levels-Only Record path. Fail-closed — never silent live vendor.

fields.name: derivedLevels
fields.description: Desk-derived MM levels (flip, walls, BALANCE / UPSIDE / DOWNSIDE TEST) carried by Slice and Levels-Only Record kinds.

fields.name: freshnessOk
fields.description: Fail-closed freshness gate for Positioning. False when capturedAt/as-of is missing or the live card is from a prior trading day. Never presents as live vendor data.

fields.name: recordKind
fields.description: Which Positioning record kind is present: position_grid, positions_by_strike, slice, or levels_only.

positioningRecordKinds.name: grid
positioningRecordKinds.summary: Primary capture panel — grid aggregations of dealer positioning (schema v1).

positioningRecordKinds.name: by-strike
positioningRecordKinds.summary: By-strike positions; Desk may aggregate from the position grid rather than capture separately.

positioningRecordKinds.name: Slice
positioningRecordKinds.summary: Price-indexed greek surface values at one moment (capturedAt/dataTime) plus Desk-derived levels at ingest. Vendor forward projections are never part of a Slice.

positioningRecordKinds.name: Levels-Only Record
positioningRecordKinds.summary: First-class Positioning record carrying only derived levels (flip, walls, BALANCE / UPSIDE / DOWNSIDE TEST) — manual-entry unit, ToS-denial steady state, and historical backlog path (ADR-025). Written via positioning_entry.

baseDetectors.name: absorption
baseDetectors.description: Base Detector: absorption / exhaustion / delta-divergence (reviewed Rust). Schema, provenance, and promotion are registry-governed. Math lives in pipelines::absorption — this registration does not change behavior.

baseDetectors.name: leg_to_leg
baseDetectors.description: Base Detector: swing-anchored leg-to-leg volume/delta profile (reviewed Rust). Schema, provenance, and promotion are registry-governed. Math lives in pipelines::leg_profile. Compact current-leg fields ride get_state; optional leg_started / leg_completed events are not Capsule-mandatory. Discovery rides search_catalog — no specialty getter.

baseDetectors.name: pinch
baseDetectors.description: Base Detector: delta-momentum pinch (reviewed Rust). Schema, provenance, and promotion are registry-governed. Math lives in pipelines::pinch — this registration does not change behavior.

baseDetectors.name: rebid_reoffer
baseDetectors.description: Base Detector: rebid/reoffer acceleration zones (reviewed Rust). Schema, provenance, and promotion are registry-governed. Math lives in pipelines::rebid_reoffer — this registration does not change behavior.

baseDetectors.name: structure
baseDetectors.description: Base Detector: structural EventDetector (IB/OR/OR5, day type, poor/excess, level tests, rvol_spike). Schema, provenance, and promotion are registry-governed. Math lives in pipelines::event_detector — this registration does not change behavior.

baseDetectors.name: trade_size
baseDetectors.description: Base Detector: trade-size distribution / large-trade cluster (reviewed Rust). Schema, provenance, and promotion are registry-governed. Math lives in pipelines::trade_size — this registration does not change behavior.
